TRPA Mission
Established in 1969, the Tahoe Regional Planning Agency was the nation’s first bi-state regional
environmental planning agency. Our mission is to lead the cooperative effort to preserve, restore, and
enhance the unique natural and human environment of the Lake Tahoe Region, while improving local
communities, and people’s interactions with our irreplaceable environment.

12. PUBLIC INTEREST COMMENTS – ON ANY MATTER

     Any member of the public wishing to address the Governing Board on any matter within TRPA’s
     jurisdiction, whether or not listed on the agenda, may do so at this time. Unless otherwise
     announced by the Chair, comments will be limited to 3 minutes per person. The Chair may set a

reduce the time allotted to individual speakers, based on the time reasonably available for the
  meeting. Any adjusted speaking time will be applied uniformly and without regard to viewpoint.


  TRPA encourages (but does not require) public comment on items agendized for possible action to
  be provided at the period designated for comment on agenda items, prior to the Governing Board’s
  consideration of the proposed action.

  A speaker who comments on an agenda item during the initial public-comment period ordinarily
  will not be permitted to comment again on the same item during general public comment. The
  Governing Board may deliberate or take action only if a matter has been listed on an agenda
  properly posted prior to the meeting. Responses from Governing Board members to unlisted public
  comment topics could become deliberation on a matter without notice to the public. To avoid this
  situation and to ensure the public has notice of all matters the Governing Board will consider,
  Board members may choose not to respond to public comments, except to correct factual
  inaccuracies, ask for staff clarification, or to ask that a matter be listed on a future agenda.

Details:
Items on the Consent Calendar are expected to be routine and non-controversial and will be acted upon
by the Board in a single motion unless removed for separate consideration. See TRPA Rule of Procedure
2.11 for procedures governing the Consent Calendar.

Meeting Instructions – Applicable to All Meetings Listed in this Notice
To Participate:
    • Join in-person at 128 Market Street, Stateline, NV 89449.
    • Visit trpa.gov for all meeting resources, including:
            o Agendas and detailed packets – available at least seven days before each meeting.
            o Virtual and call-in details – available at least one day before each meeting.
            o Supporting materials may also be requested from Marja Ambler, Tahoe Regional
                 Planning Agency, 128 Market Street, Stateline, NV 89449, mambler@trpa.gov, (775)
                 589-5287.
    • For questions, contact TRPA staff at virtualmeetinghelp@trpa.gov or (775) 588-4547.
    • TRPA will make reasonable efforts to assist and accommodate persons with disabilities that wish
        to participate. For assistance, contact Marja Ambler, mambler@trpa.gov, (775) 589-5287.

Contributing Public Comment:

   •   Written: Please submit comments by 3 p.m. the day before the meeting. Email: You may email
       comments to publiccomment@trpa.gov. Include meeting details and agenda item in the subject
       line or write "General Comment" for non-agenda items.
   •   You may also send by mail, fax to (775) 588-4527, or drop off in person at 128 Market Street.
   •   Verbal: Public comment periods are provided as identified in each meeting agenda. Unless
       otherwise announced by the Chair, public comment is limited to 3 minutes per person. The
       Chair may reasonably reduce individual speaking time based on the number of persons wishing
       to comment and the time reasonably available for the meeting. The Chair may establish or
       extend aggregate time limits as provided in the applicable agenda. All public comment
       restrictions will be applied uniformly and without regard to viewpoint. Unused speaking time
       may not be transferred to another person.
   •   Comment on agenda items  comment period at the beginning of the meeting.
   •   Comment on any topic within TRPA/TMPO’s jurisdiction  comment period at the end of the
       meeting.
   •   The Chair may enforce applicable speaking times and take reasonable measures, including
       calling a recess, to address conduct that actually disrupts or impedes the orderly conduct of the
       meeting. A person who willfully disrupts a meeting to the extent that its orderly conduct is made
       impractical may be removed.
